metadata.purpose: Construct two separately subscribed filter results, with inverse predicate admission and independent indexed callback state.

conditions: Each branch separately subscribes to the source; results are not necessarily a single shared execution.
Pass accepts exactly values whose branch-specific predicate outcome is true; fail accepts values with false.
Each subscription uses its own zero-based index; completion, error, cancellation and callback throw are branch-local.
Predicate output is a routing decision, not a modification of the opaque payload.

scope.parameters: Predicate/value input, no deprecated thisArg; both result branches separately subscribed in the model witness.
scope.callbacks: An indexed predicate callback runs once per source next PER BRANCH. Callback outcomes are correlated to branch and index, not computed internally.
scope.time: Each independent upstream subscription supplies its own time; cold sources can execute twice, hot sources can share an external producer.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic indexed predicate request and resolution before the next event for that branch.
exclusions: A single shared-source router is explicitly not partition. Only one subscription per result branch is modeled; multiple subscribers to either result are out of scope.
Synchronous reentrancy during predicate evaluation, deprecated thisArg and throwing observer/finalizers.

initialization.sourceSubscription: The modeled witness connects both returned Observables, resulting in TWO source subscriptions.

ownership.sharing: No implicit sharing. Two branches independently subscribe to the source; one closing does not close the other.
ownership.reset: Each branch has its own index and pending predicate; source teardown is independent.

resources.owner: one source subscription per branch, generation 0/1

dispatch.actionSemantics: Request one predicate per input to each subscribed branch; only the appropriate branch may receive a next.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between branch events and their resolved callbacks; cancellation is branch-local.
